author: Original procedural audio created for this addon
original_title: Energy Blade

name: Warcraft Wolf Howl
author: Blizzard Entertainment
license: Game-owned asset, not bundled or redistributed by this addon
changes: Replaced the former non-Warcraft recording. Playback uses the installed game sound kit with its per-sound volume override. Known classic and modern wolf-howl kit IDs are tried in that order; availability in the user client still needs preview validation.
